name: JG_EXG_RATE_DIF_LINE
description: JG_EXG_RATE_DIF_LINE contains line level details of records in JG_EXG_RATE_DIF table.

columns.name: ER_DIF_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier associated with each line record. This is the primary key column in this table.

columns.name: ER_DIF_ID
columns.description: Identifier associated with each line record. This is the primary key column in this table.

columns.name: AE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Number that is associated with each subledger journal entry line.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Number of the invoice or transaction line.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Type of invoice or transaction line.Valid values from INVOICE LINE TYPE lookup codes for payables or receivables lookup code for STD_LINE_TYPE.

columns.name: ERD_AMT
columns.description: Exchange rate difference line amount in invoice currency.

columns.name: TAX_AMT
columns.description: Tax line amount in invoice currency.

columns.name: LINE_DIST_ID
columns.description: Distribution identifier of invoice or transaction.

columns.name: APPL_TO_DIST_ID
columns.description: Invoice distribution to which 100% of current charge is applied.

columns.name: CUST_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate name associated with tax rate identifier. Tax_rate_id is unique while a tax_rate_code may have different tax rates based on date ranges.

columns.name: TAX_CODE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for tax rate effective on the invoice date.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax classification code used.

columns.name: TAXES_APPLIED
columns.description: Applied taxes.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Tax rate.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code.

columns.name: TAX_CCID
columns.description: Tax code combination identifier.

columns.name: AMOUNT_INCLUDES_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Describes whether amount includes tax amount or not.

columns.name: SLA_CCID
columns.description: Code combination identifier of subledger accounting entry.

columns.name: AWT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Withholding tax group identifier.

columns.name: CUST_GAIN_CCID
columns.description: Clearing gain code combination identifier selected from global descriptive flexfield on manage common options for payables and procurement or manage receivables system options.

columns.name: CUST_LOSS_CCID
columns.description: Clearing loss code combination identifier selected from global descriptive flexfield on manage common options for payables and procurement or manage receivables system options.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
